Name: Male Servant Zee fix (reupload)
Author: Nalibae
Description:
[center][line]

[color=#6d9eeb][size=5][font=Serif][i]Male Servant Zee functions as a manservant who brings you food each day. He worries and fear for your safety. [/i][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=6]Description[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]It is the same [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26596]mod [u]by[/u] [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/WanNe777?gameId=1303]WanNe777[/url]. I play on heavy moded farm and Zee started having gifting issue so I took it myself and found a fix. The issue with gifting, and spawn point for Zee on farm house 1 to 3 should be fixed. See config to customize his schedule. His spawn point is at the "[b]kitchen[/b]". You can edit the schedule yourself where you want Zee to move in the farmhouse as well. He might still glitch on furniture if its in his way but the schedule should minimize it. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679]Debug Mode[/url] to figure which tile coordinate you want for his schedule, set it on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] in-game config. Customize the schedule to make him avoid any furniture. That way he will not clip on them. His portrait getting cropped in game has been fixed but the resolution of the portrait is reduced. To use the HD portrait, read and follow the [color=#00ff00]installation instruction[/color] below. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4][u]Tested and should be compatible with any expansion mods. [/u][/size][/center]
[center][size=3]Important: Please see [color=#ff0000]note[/color] below.[/size][/center]
[center][left][size=3][u]Summary[/u][/size][/left]
[left][list]
[*][size=3]Gifting issue fix[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Spawn for house 1 - 3 fix[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Portrait clipping fixed[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]HD Portrait for Portraiture separated to be placed in Portraiture[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Config optimized[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Compatibility optimized[/size][/*]
[/list][/left]
[/center]
[center][b][size=6]How to navigate the config[/size][/b]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=5]House Level[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]Set the bar to whichever your farm house level is upgraded ([color=#ffff00]Upgrade 1[/color], [color=#ffff00]Upgrade 2[/color], [color=#9900ff]Upgrade 3[/color]). At level 1 and 2, Zee will be in a constant location and will not move. He is in a fixed position. At level 3, he will be in his full schedule where he will roam around the farmhouse.[/size]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]Upgrade 1 & 2 Tile Coordinate[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]This is his fixed position for Farmhouse 1 and 2. It is set on[/size][u][size=4] X: 3, Y: 8[/size][/u][size=4] by default. Set the bar to your desired location if he is inside a furniture. Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679][size=4]Debug Mode[/size][/url][size=4] to figure out the tile coordinate. This coords strictly applies to House Upgrade 1 (Base house) and House Upgrade 2.[/size]

[b][color=#9900ff][size=5]Upgrade 3 Tile Coordinates[/size][/color][/b]
[size=4]This is his full schedule where he can walk and roam the farmhouse. This schedule strictly applies when you have set the House Level bar to 3 (House Upgraded Level 3). On default, he has 4 locations to go. You can disregard the titles ([/size][i][size=4]Kitchen, Living Room, Bedroom, and Children Room[/size][/i][size=4]) and set the coords wherever spot in the farmhouse you want Zee to go. As mentioned above, "[/size][b][size=4]Kitchen[/size][/b][size=4]" is his spawn point. That is where he will appear every time you wake up. Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/679][size=4]Debug Mode[/size][/url][size=4] to figure out the right tile coordinate.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55439/55439-1794499075-228009730.png[/img][/size]

[size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55439/55439-1794499075-887182529.png[/img][/size]


[color=#ff0000][size=4]Note: If you have this mod already installed before, installing this update might reset your friendship points with Zee. This mod is set on English translation. I have translated it myself using a translator and you might find the dialogue odd. Feel free to use the existing English translation found [/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34892][size=4]here[/size][/url][size=4].[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#00ff00][size=6]Installation instructions[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]1. Download the zip file and extract it. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]2. Drop the folder in the game's Mod folder. [/size][/center]
[center][size=4]3. Inside Male Servant Zee folder, open the Portraiture folder and move the HD png file to Portraiture mod to use the HD portrait (make sure you have a folder ready for the png file inside Portraiture).[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]4. In-game, check GMCM config and edit his schedule.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]You will need SMAPI and GMCM installed for the mod to work and I suggest you install Debug Mode for the tile coordinates. [/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][size=6]Shout outs[/size][/b][/center]
[center][size=4]All thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/WanNe777?gameId=1303]WanNe777[/url] for letting me update the mod.[/size][/center]
